items.title: Simpler navigation and a calmer home page
items.summary: Four clear menu groups, a full-screen phone menu and search that's always one tap away.

items.title: Creator glossary: 80 terms
items.summary: Plain definitions for 80 creator terms, from CPM to usage rights and whitelisting.

items.title: Animated link previews
items.summary: Links to our pages play a short animated preview when you share them in iMessage and Discord.

items.title: Free tools and creator rate pages

items.title: Honest tool reviews and comparisons
items.summary: Neutral reviews of Stan, Beacons, Linktree and more, with real fees and side-by-side comparisons, and no affiliate links.

items.title: The site in Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese
items.summary: The home page, Guides, menus and the first guides in Spanish at /es/ and Brazilian Portuguese at /pt-br/.

items.title: Rate Check: unlisted first version
items.summary: The anonymous rate-sharing page, built and running privately while we gather enough rates to show.

items.title: The Select Weekly newsletter
items.summary: A weekly email with what changed on the platforms and the best new guides.

items.title: See what people search for that we don't cover yet
items.summary: Count searches that find nothing, without cookies or tracking, so we know which guides to write next.

items.title: Printable deal checklist and contract templates
items.summary: A one-page deal checklist you can print or save as a PDF, and starter templates for common creator agreements.

items.title: Install as an app and read saved guides offline
items.summary: Add Select Creators to your home screen and read the guides you saved without a connection.

items.title: Lighter pages: smaller styles on every guide
items.summary: Make guides load faster on phones by only sending the styles each page needs.

items.title: More case studies beyond YouTube and TikTok
items.summary: Case studies of creators on LinkedIn, Pinterest, Twitch and newsletters, a UGC creator, and creators outside the US, each with what you can copy.

items.title: Money guides for the UK, EU, Canada and Australia
items.summary: Taxes, business setup and getting paid for creators outside the US.

items.title: Ask AI, round two: prompt starters and assistant access
items.summary: Ready-made prompts on each guide, like "price this deal for me", and a way for Claude, ChatGPT and other assistants to search the whole handbook.

items.title: Which paywall? A side-by-side picker
items.summary: Answer a few questions and compare fan platforms on fees, payout timing and what they allow, side by side.

items.title: A no-pressure way to ask our team for help
items.summary: A simple "talk to us" path for creators who want help with deals or representation, with our agency link disclosed up front, and an honest "you don't need a manager yet" when that's true.

items.title: Brand management, personal brand and burnout
items.summary: Guides on building a brand that outlives one platform, handling a crisis, managing your community, saying no, and avoiding burnout.

items.title: Fill the tool directory with free alternatives
items.summary: Around 60 creator tools across link-in-bio, email, scheduling, payments, editing and AI, each with an honest take and a free alternative.

items.title: Grow: hooks, retention and posting cadence in depth
items.summary: Deeper Grow guides on hooks and the first three seconds, reading retention curves, how often to post and what the evidence says, with interactive examples.

items.title: Serve app icons from our own site
items.summary: Tool and app icons will load from creators.select instead of an outside icon service, so no third party sees your visit and pages load faster.

items.title: Mark finished guides published, with bylines
items.summary: Most guides still say "draft". We'll review each one, show who wrote and checked it, and mark it published.

items.title: Translate more guides into Spanish and Portuguese
items.summary: More guides in Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese, starting with the ones creators read most: platforms, brand deals and getting paid.

items.title: Lawyer review of Underground and contract guides
items.summary: A lawyer checks our gray-market reporting and our contract and deal guides before launch.

items.title: CPA review of the Money guides
items.summary: A licensed CPA checks our tax, set-aside, LLC and S corp guides so every number and rule is right before we mark them reviewed.

items.title: Creator directory and a redesigned Stack page
items.summary: Browse real creators and the gear and software they use, on a cleaner Stack page organized by budget and job.

items.title: Who reps who: search agency rosters
items.summary: Search talent agencies and managers by the creators they represent, so you can see who works with creators like you, plus the tools agencies use.

items.title: Open Rate Check: see what creators were actually paid
items.summary: A page where creators anonymously share what brands actually paid them and see the middle range for their platform and size. It's built and waiting on spam protection before it opens.

items.title: Public roadmap and changelog
items.summary: A public board showing what we're building now, what's next and what shipped, plus a dated list of every update to the site.
